In this week’s Starship Update, we break down the latest from SpaceX’s Starbase and Florida operations following Flight 12, now officially classified by the FAA as a mishap after Booster 19’s boostback burn failure. At the production site, Gigabay continues climbing with interior scaffolding and door guides going in, while the Starfactory shows off a unique nosecone already fitted with a hatch.

Ship 41 is fully stacked on the middle workstand in Megabay 2 with aft flaps installed ahead of cryo testing, Booster 21 has received its transfer tube, and four-point lifters are back in action at Sanchez. Post-flight inspections at Pad 2 reveal scaffolding on the orbital launch mount, retracted BQDs with new cover plates, lowered chopsticks, and removed landing rails, while the ASU begins work on its new cooling station.
